commenti.body:
I watched it and I was in awe. Also I had visited berlin righ in 2016 so I felt very close to the athmosphere of the film and I swear I could have seen it develping in front of my eyes while I was visiting.

February 2016 and it was so cold.

I watched movie after being tio Berlin and it spoke to me a lot: berlin is the city where a lot of youth goes to and where  it is easy to get lost. I think Victoria motivation were about getting lost in a totally different environment and willing to do the craziest thing. 

Many youth go to Berlint with tha attitude, so following those locals was something "risky" but a risk she was willing to take on order to forget her spanish life. 

This is what I got: also following them on the rooftop and so on. 

I absolutely agree about the fact of finding the four boys very "rapey" in the beginning scnee and I though the movie would have gone in that direction while instead... it took a nice different turn. 

Her motivation was starting over but she got more than she bargained for.

I also found the discotheque scene "perfect".

I really liked it in concept, but was not really a fan of the execution. The single-take sounds good in marketing material, but it also really limits mobility and where the actors can go and what they can do.

But I'll admit, ending the movie like a real-time sunrise? That was something special.
